description: This source file defines the RedisClusteringProviderBuilder class which implements configuration logic for Redis clustering in Orleans, including methods for configuring silo and client builders with Redis connection options.

classes.name: RedisClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements the IProviderBuilder interface for both ISiloBuilder and IClientBuilder, configuring Redis clustering options for Orleans silo and client setups.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the provided builder (silo or client) by setting up Redis clustering via options, including connection multiplexer initialization from service keys or connection strings.
